token.title: 🔑 GitHub tɔkɛn
token.intro: GitHub gye abisa 60 dɔnhwerew biara ma address a ɛmfa tɔkɛn nsoma. Fork dua a ɛyɛ pɛ gye bɛyɛ 32, enti nsrahwɛ a ɛto so abien no nya hwee. Tɔkɛn ma anohyeto no kɔ soro kosi 5000 dɔnhwerew biara.
token.step1: Bue Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, na afei Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: wo ankasa wo akawnt. Expiration: da biara, dua no nhia biribi a ɛtena hɔ kyɛ.
token.step4: Mfa wo nsa nka kwan biara. Badwam akorae ho nsɛm nhia emu biara.
token.step5: Yɛ no, na afei fa {token} bo no. GitHub kyerɛ no pɛnkoro pɛ.
token.classic: Tɔkɛn dedaw nso yɛ adwuma: yɛ baako a wonhyɛɛ baabiara agyiraehyɛde. Kwan hunu mpo kenkan badwam nsɛm wɔ ahoɔhare a wɔagye atom no so.
token.paste: Fa hyɛ baabi a wɔkyerɛw no mu
token.stays: Ɛtena browsa yi mu wɔ safe {key} ase na ɛkɔ {host} nko ara. Wɔnkyerɛw no wɔ address baa no mu da, enti link a wokyɛ no de nhwɛso no na ɛkɔ, ɛnyɛ wo krataa. Bɔtɔn a ɛwɔ baabi a wɔkyerɛw no ase no pepa no bio ne cache no.
token.persistHow: Fa tɔkɛn no hyɛ {env} fael a ɛwɔ sɛva a ɛkura krataafa yi so no mu, {port} nkyɛn:
token.proxy: na fa {make} hyɛ ase. Afei kɔntena no kyerɛw nginx asɛm tiaa bi a ɛde {header} ti no ka {path} proxy ho, enti browsa no frɛ ne fibea ankasa na ɛnnya tɔkɛn no da. Baabi a wɔkyerɛw yi yera na ɔhɔho biara kyɛ sika koro a ɛyɛ 5000 dɔnhwerew biara.
fork.refused404: Dubaa nsensanee biara nni hɔ: {message}. 404 wɔ ha kyerɛ dubaa a ɛnni hɔ anaa ɔkwan a sɛva proxy no mfa; fork ntam a ɛwɔ soro no yɛ pɛ biara mu.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub abisa asa wɔ dɔnhwerew yi mu, enti wɔantumi ansiesie dubaa nsensanee biara. Fork ntam a ɛwɔ soro no yɛ pɛ. Fa tɔkɛn ka ho wɔ nyiyimu panel no mu, anaa dum dubaa nsensanee wɔ nhyehyɛe panel no mu na wode sika no ahyɛ ntam no nkutoo.
